scope: S7 config fallback preserves validated existing proof; two-file90bf35a7 handoff
accepted_boundaries: Existing qualified facts are passed through validate_fact_claim against their original proof before returning the exact fact object. No source VALUE proof is replaced by a new config proof, and stale document/value/reader mismatches remain validator errors.

For unqualified VALUE facts, the selected candidate event reader set must exactly equal the fact declared reader tuple before construction. Another consumer with equal value/path cannot supply the missing proof. Original path, exact event value/status, raw checkpoint value, fingerprint and document-token checks remain unchanged.

S7 passes the prepared root document for its fallback over aggregate facts. Preserved source proofs keep their original supplying document; this branch does not rebind them to that fallback document or mint any new token. Requiring every existing child-source proof to become root-scoped would be incorrect.
Three controls inspect actual diffusion source proof object identity, stale existing config proof rejection, and same-value foreign consumer refusal. Assertions not executed by reviewer.
limits: Original twentyfirst S7 generator failure remains historical actual evidence; source correction does not relabel it.
No runtime/model/test execution, artifact regeneration or output approval by reviewer.
Existing proof variant semantics and validator scope are unchanged; this review accepts the fallback behavior only.
